properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (code read, 0.92.0): propagate_change full:true takes no budget_chars and no paging, so on a 35-seed change its 38,395-character radius was withheld whole at flo2's door (limit 29,267); propagate_from was given a budget on 2026-10-23 and its sibling propagate_change was not, and the bounded-replies gate never calls a tool with a required argument
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause), 2026-10-26, flo2 trial on a sample apartment building design (reflow2 0.92.0).

① OBSERVED: propagate_change {full: true} on a change touching 35 nodes answered reply_too_large (38,395 against 29,267 characters) with no way to page; only max_depth 3 fit. NOT affected: the default summary, and propagate_from.

② PRECEDENT: reflow2:fact:the-rocket-equation-rung-ran-on-0-90-0-and-a-unit-check-caught-a-nasa-formula-but-reflow2-checks-no-units-2026-10-23 ("propagate_from's reply cannot be bounded"), fixed for propagate_from only in reflow2:chg:replies-fit-2026-10-23; flo2's whole-reply-withheld class (1a97fc1f1de4d5d2:fact:list-my-design-files-is-withheld-whole-on-a-design-with-many-files-and-cannot-be-paged-2026-10-26).

③ CANDIDATES: (a) reflow2's propagate_change has no bound; (b) OUTSIDE reflow2: flo2's gateway failed to pass a budget it could have passed; (c) the reply is the stale_edge_evidence riding along, not the radius; (d) the gate that should catch an unbounded reply did not run on this tool.

④–⑤ MEASURED in source: (a) holds: PropagateChangeReq declares no budget_chars, limit or offset (service.rs ~5921); the handler serializes the full radius (coherence.rs ~1030). (b) refuted: flo2's withEngineBudget (budget.ts) passes a budget only to a tool whose schema takes budget_chars, and narrowFor names only arguments the tool takes; propagate_change takes none of NARROWING ('depth' is not 'max_depth'), so the door can do nothing but withhold. (c) cannot be separated without the reply: both the radius and stale_edge_evidence (one coverage note per seed with no prior snapshot, 35 seeds) grow with seed count; not measured. (d) holds: tools/replies_are_bounded.py calls only tools with no required argument plus a hand list (loop_status, scan_nodes, get_skill, propagate_from full); propagate_change requires change_event_id, so it is never measured.

⑥ CLASS: an instance fixed (propagate_from) while its sibling sharing the same payload (propagate_change) was left, and a gate whose population is "tools callable with no arguments". Would the class fix have stopped this? A gate that builds a minimal valid call for every read-shaped reply, or a single budgeted serializer for the BlastRadius used by both tools, would have.

RECOMMENDED, by correctness: (1) propagate_change takes budget_chars and pages `impacted` the same way propagate_from does (one shared bounded serializer for the radius), with stale_edge_evidence counted inside the budget; (2) replies_are_bounded.py adds propagate_change {change_event_id, full: true} on a seeded change, and in general derives a call for tools with required ids from the export; pin with that case failing today. (3) flo2: NARROWING could name `max_depth`, which did shorten it.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: how much of the 38,395 was stale_edge_evidence; the trial's exact reply (not kept). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
